matrix_name.name: polyurethane
matrix_name.description: Cross-linked polyurethane network prepared from oligooxypropylene glycol (OPG) and 2,4-tolylenediisocyanate (TDI) with 1,1,1-trimethylolpropane (TMP) as a crosslinking agent. Modified with 1 wt% iron(III) acetylacetonate (Fe(acac)3).

fillers.name: carbon nanotubes
fillers.description: Multiwall carbon nanotubes (CNT) with a length of 5-10 um, an outer diameter of 20 nm, and a surface area of 190 m2/g. Introduced via ultrasonic dispersion.
